messages:
IncidentBot: ALERT: Route /v1/generate p99 spike detected for region us-west-2. p95 is 420ms (SLO 250ms), p99 is 1.8s (SLO 800ms). Streaming stall traces observed. Auto-escalation -> incidents channel.
Rachel (oncall): I'm on it. Confirming scope: is this across all models or a subset?
Maya (sre): Seeing elevated latencies across gptx-medium and gptx-large routes. Not global — predominantly us-west-2 and a couple of edge POPs.
Javier (runtime): Just saw a deploy completed ~3m ago: commit a3c9fb9 -> rollout hash-scheme:v4. deploy-bot shows: `deploy id: 2026-03-15T20:58:12Z`.
Rachel (oncall): Copy. Adding logs: `streaming stalls: handler_wait > 500ms` in 14% of requests on p99.
Dmitri (cs): FYI a few customers (enterprise-A, partner-b) pinged support with slowed responses and some partial streaming failures. They reported timeouts at ~30s for long responses.
Maya (sre): Quick check: cache hit rate for prefix-caching layer dropped from ~88% -> 22% after rollout. KV namespace parity shows many keys missing from new hash buckets.
Javier (runtime): That matches. hash-scheme:v4 changed the prefix->bucket mapping to reduce collisions but we missed the migration step for the pre-warmed keyset. Keys landed in different buckets, leaving cold reads.
Leah (product): What customer-impact classification? SLO breach confirmed for p95/p99 on gen endpoints. Potential severity P1 if we can't fix in 30m.
Rachel (oncall): Escalating to P1. Oncall runbook step 1: verify rollback toggle. Can someone confirm if we can flip the rollout flag?
Javier (runtime): I can flip the rollout to v3 parity for serving only (no restarts). Command: `./ops/rollout toggle --service=prefixing --to=hash-scheme:v3 --dry-run=false`
Rachel (oncall): Do it. Post when started.
deploy-bot: ACTION: rollout toggle started by javier at 5409876570. Target: hash-scheme:v3 -> 100% traffic.
Maya (sre): While that runs, enabling aggressive prefix warmup and increasing cache TTL for current keys: `cachectl prewarm --namespace=prefix_v3 --rate=200qps` and `cachectl set-ttl --namespace=prefix_v3 --ttl=5m`
Javier (runtime): Rollback completed. deploy-bot: rollout toggle finished at 5409876602. Traffic now on hash-scheme:v3.
Rachel (oncall): Monitoring p95/p99 now.
Maya (sre): Hit rate climbing: 22% -> 65% within 30s of warmup. p95 dropped to 260ms, p99 at 720ms and trending down. Streaming replays show stalls decreasing.
Dmitri (cs): Notifying impacted customers with status update: brief explanation + ETA ~20m for stabilization. Sending copy for review: "We experienced a routing change that affected cache key parity during a rollout. We've reverted to the previous keying scheme and are warming caches; you should see latency improvements shortly."
Leah (product): Thanks. We should also add this case to rollout checklist: ensure keyspace migration step and prewarm before flip.
Javier (runtime): Root cause: rollout changed hash mapping without migration for the namespace; prewarm step was in the rollout plan but not executed due to a CI gating error. I'll open a PR to require prewarm job success as a gating check.
Maya (sre): Temporary mitigation in place. Recommend keeping the rollback for at least 15m and watch regional parity.
Rachel (oncall): Agreed. I'll start a 15m watch and handoff after stabilization. Next oncall @Leah on call rotation — will hand off at 5409876705 with notes.
IncidentBot: NOTE: Incident severity set to P1 -> updates every 5 minutes until resolved.
Leah (product): I'll take handoff. Please attach postmortem template + timeline and the rollout PR id.
Javier (runtime): PR opened: #4820 "enforce prewarm-gate for hash-scheme rollouts".
Maya (sre): Current status at 5409876705: p95 230ms, p99 410ms in us-west-2; hit rate stabilized ~86%. Marking as mitigated but keeping channel open for root-cause.
Rachel (oncall): Handoff to Leah: everything noted. If anything regresses, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
Dmitri (cs): I'll follow up with the customers and share the official incident note once postmortem is ready.
Leah (product): Will open the incident doc and schedule RCA meeting. Thanks team.
